title: Flattened very quickly , not supportive at all.
text: Flattened very quickly , not supportive at all.. Returned this pillow because it was a big disappointment. It flattened out quickly and I am not a heavy person. I thought it was going to support my low back/lumbar area and it was nearly useless. For $25 it definitely was not worth it. Save your money .
